## Formål

Denne dokumenterte R-pipen lager `data/player_seasons.csv` uten å endre
`data/player_bio.csv`. Når et navn matcher nøyaktig én bio-rad, brukes bioens
eksisterende `playerID`. Ukoblede eller tvetydige sesongspillere beholdes med
en stabil `season_name_...`-ID og rapporteres separat.

Review-output samles i `results/review_player_seasons/`. Dette gjør
`results/` ryddig samtidig som koblinger, lønnskonflikter og reduksjoner kan
etterprøves.

## Kjør pipen

```{r}
result <- source("scripts/create_player_seasons.R")
```

## Strukturell validering

```{r}
seasons <- read.csv("data/player_seasons.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                    check.names = FALSE)
bio <- read.csv("data/player_bio.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                check.names = FALSE)
report <- read.csv("results/player_seasons_report.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
linkage <- read.csv("results/review_player_seasons/player_seasons_linkage.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(paste(seasons$playerID, seasons$season)))
stopifnot(all(nzchar(seasons$playerID)), all(!is.na(seasons$full_name)),
          all(nzchar(seasons$full_name)),
          all(!is.na(seasons$first_name)), all(nzchar(seasons$first_name)),
          all(is.na(seasons$last_name) | nzchar(seasons$last_name) |
                !grepl(" ", seasons$full_name, fixed = TRUE)))
stopifnot(all(seasons$season >= 1996 & seasons$season <= 2025))
expected_columns <- c(
  "playerID", "season", "first_name", "last_name", "full_name", "salary",
  "position", "season_height", "season_weight", "team_abbreviation",
  "games_played", "games_started", "minutes_pg", "fgm_pg", "fga_pg",
  "fgpct_pg", "3pm_pg", "3pa_pg", "3p_pct", "2pm_pg", "2pa_pg", "2p_pct",
  "efg%", "ftm_pg", "fta_pg", "ftpct", "oreb_pg", "dreb_pg", "treb_pg",
  "ast_pg", "stl_pg", "blk_pg", "tov_pg", "pts_pg", "net_rating", "oreb_pct",
  "dreb_pct", "usg_pct", "ts_pct", "ast_pct", "playerID_status"
)
stopifnot(identical(names(seasons), expected_columns))
matched <- seasons$playerID_status == "matched_bio"
stopifnot(all(seasons$playerID[matched] %in% bio$playerID))
stopifnot(all(!grepl("^season_name_", seasons$playerID[matched])))
stopifnot(all(seasons$playerID[!matched] %in%
              linkage$playerID[linkage$linkage_status != "matched_bio"]))
stopifnot(all(seasons$playerID_status %in%
              c("matched_bio", "unmatched_bio", "ambiguous_bio")))
report
table(seasons$playerID_status)
colSums(is.na(seasons[c("salary", "games_played", "team_abbreviation",
                        "season_height", "season_weight", "3p_pct", "efg%")]))
```

Alle kontroller over er eksplisitte `stopifnot()`-krav. En feil stopper
renderingen i stedet for å produsere en suksessformet, men ugyldig output.
